name: 張陽郎
objective:
Graduate students need to integrate information and innovative insights to successfully achieve a MS or PhD degree. The course includes: 
1. Characteristics of good researchers. 
2. Research planning. 
3. Learning method. 
4. Innovative thinking. 
5. Writing method. 
6. Present method. 
7. Research design practice
schedule: The week schedule is based on the curriculum arrangement of the UTA AI class at EECS college.
scorePolicy: The grading will be evaluated by attendance rate and feedback reports.
materials: Self-compiled teaching materials include personalized, and curated resources tailored to specific curriculum needs, and learning objectives.
consultation: For course inquiries, please refer to the information provided by the UTA AI class at EECS college.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG3：良好健康和福祉（Good Health and Well-being）SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG7：可負擔的潔淨能源（Affordable and Clean Energy）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）

name: 黃育賢
objective:
